title: The Lich Question
description: Follow The Graveyard's own Lich progression far enough to summon one and reach its Lich Prison milestone. REIGN treats this as evidence about a particular form of undeath and binding, not as a definition of resurrection, Lifeforce, or the fate of every soul.
description_completed: The Graveyard's Lich sequence has been confronted through its native progression.

prerequisites.name: Survey The Graveyard's places of death
